about: Lot 282 (Tappa Prove P0): the mass-write arm of ConfirmedIntrusion on its own, every shape of it, never reaches COMBAT nor the ladder. An unpackaged worker of a service (no login session, scoped by its unit) rewrites twenty distinct existing files in place (the kernel's overwrite crossing, each file once): ConfirmedIntrusion, file-system evidence, ENGAGED. A window later it rewrites twenty more, then creates twenty files and destroys twenty originals (the replacement shape), and its cgroup's workers cross the cgroup window: the arm again each time, and the ransomware tracker's shapes of the same actor (RansomwareEncryption, file-system evidence too, held behind the policy) — no signal of another kind of evidence in the unit's scope vouches for any of them: ENGAGED still, the ladder never engaged, nothing killed.
